title: Law to require reporting on paid social media influencer posts
summary: This bill would require public servants who use city funds for third-party public communications, such as paid influencer posts, to report details to the Department of Records and Information Services within 60 days, including the author, platforms used, subject matter and cost. DORIS would then have to publish this information on the city's open data portal, quarterly in election years and twice yearly otherwise. The law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
